text: おすと　メニューが　ひらくなり

structure.jp: メニューが　ひらくなり

patterns.name: 〜と (when)
patterns.explanation: と after a plain verb says 'when this happens, that always follows'. おすと = 'when you press it'.

patterns.name: 〜なり
patterns.explanation: なり at the end is an old-fashioned 'it is', used here as a funny way of talking. ひらくなり = 'it opens, so it does'.
